name: Amethyst clock
description: A clock set into an amethyst geode on a bronze stand, showing the real time: its rose-gold hands turn with the time of day and the seconds hand ticks.

name: Armillary
description: Steel rings round a glowing core.

name: Astronaut
description: A photo of an astronaut on the right, looking out at a slowly turning sky with the Milky Way, thousands of stars and the odd shooting star. The sun glints on the visor and a helmet light blinks.

name: Astronaut blackhole
description: The astronaut faces a black hole, from NASA's visualization of one (NASA Goddard / Jeremy Schnittman, SVS 14619).

name: Astronaut galaxy
description: The astronaut faces the Whirlpool Galaxy, M51, and its small companion (NASA, ESA, S. Beckwith, Hubble Heritage Team), tinted toward the violet in the visor.

name: Astronaut nebula
description: The astronaut faces the Pillars of Creation in the Eagle Nebula (NASA, ESA, Hubble Heritage Team, 2014), tinted toward the emerald in the visor.

name: Astronaut pulsar
description: The astronaut faces the Crab Nebula, the wreck of a star that exploded in 1054, with the pulsar it left spinning at its heart (NASA/CXC/SAO, STScI, JPL-Caltech composite).

name: Aurora
description: Slow curtains of light over a starry night sky.

name: Betta
description: A red and blue fighting fish hanging in the dark water.

name: Book
description: An old leather book floating open in the dark, golden light pouring out of it.

name: Bottle
description: A thunderstorm trapped in a corked glass bottle.

name: Car
description: A black supercar in the rain at night.

name: Chess
description: A black marble king split by gold-filled cracks.

name: Crystals
description: A cluster of glowing green and purple crystals on a dark rock.

name: Door
description: Stone steps climbing through fog to an open door full of golden light.

name: Dragon
description: A black dragon veined with fire, alive. It looks slowly about, breathes deeply with its chest swelling and smoke puffing from its nostrils, beats its wings and blinks.

name: Dragon clock
description: A green dragon asleep, curled round a bronze clock on a slab of slate.

name: Feather
description: A black feather burning along one edge, drifting in the dark.

name: Foxmask
description: A white kitsune mask hanging on red cords in drifting smoke.

name: Ghostship
description: A ragged galleon at night on a dark sea.

name: Gradient
description: Four soft color blobs wandering slowly. The cheapest of the bundled shaders.

name: Guitar
description: A black electric guitar edged in blue light.

name: Katana
description: A katana hangs in the dark while cherry blossom petals drift down around it, tumbling and swaying, some behind the blade and some in front, near ones soft as if out of focus and lit pink as they pass the blade's glow.

name: Lighthouse
description: A lighthouse on a rock in a dark sea. Its beam turns round and round: it sweeps out to the left through the haze, flashes as it faces you, sweeps out to the right and passes behind the tower.

name: Manta
description: A glowing manta gliding through the dark sea.

name: Mech
description: A black armoured robot in red smoke. The smoke streams up and away from it, more drifts in around it, the armour's red lights pulse like a heartbeat, a scan of light runs along the visor every few seconds, and embers drift up.

name: Meteor
description: A burning rock floating in the dark, split by cracks of lava.

name: Moon
description: The moon close up against black space, its edge lit blue-white.

name: Northern lights
description: Green aurora over snowy mountains and a still lake.

name: Planet cosmic
description: A blue and violet world veined with molten orange, its rings streaming violet and blue. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet crystal
description: A cracked blue world ringed with tumbling ice crystals. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet eclipse
description: A dark world eclipsing its star, the corona flaring gold behind it. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet ember
description: A burning world with fiery cracks and blazing orange rings, in drifting embers. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet ice
description: An ice world ringed with glittering crystal shards, in teal frost clouds. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet neon
description: A violet world in neon magenta and blue rings, wrapped in purple nebula. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet sapphire
description: A deep blue world with wide sapphire rings sweeping across the screen. A still picture brought to life.

name: Planet storm
description: A blue world with a great spiral storm, ringed in electric blue. A still picture brought to life.

name: Plasma
description: Smooth, dark, slowly morphing color fields.

name: Prism
description: A glass prism hanging on a cord splits a white beam into a rainbow.

name: Projector
description: An old film projector running in the dark.

name: Raven
description: A clockwork raven perched on a rock.

name: Ribbon
description: Glossy glass ribbons twisting through the dark, with pink and blue light streaming to the right through them like light through fibre optics.

name: Ring gold
description: An art-deco ring of brushed gold, its grooved bands joined by chevrons.

name: Ring moon
description: A ring of moon rock, cratered and grey, set between thin silver rims. The rock band slowly turns inside its rims while the light on it stays put, so its craters travel round, and glints of light slide along the polished silver.

name: Ring neon
description: A brushed-metal ring lit cyan and magenta on black. It slowly spins, so the coloured light travels round it, a bright glint runs round the brushed metal, and the neon glow breathes.

name: Sakura pond
description: A glowing cherry tree leans over dark water at night.

name: Skull
description: A skull wreathed in smoke, white on one side and lit red on the other.

name: Snowglobe
description: A mountain cabin inside a glass globe.

name: Starfield
description: Three layers of stars drifting at different speeds, with a faint nebula.

name: Tree
description: A broad green tree on black.

name: Watch
description: An open skeleton pocket watch in warm light.

name: Waterfall
description: A tiny waterfall in a glass cube.

name: Waves
description: Layered translucent ribbons drifting across a deep gradient.

name: Bubble
description: A particles.js effect, simulated natively. Touch the screen to play with it.
